what_this_file_is: The key of every capability item: the exact value, the source file, the source version or checksum, and how the value was read. The values come from the PRIMARY sources, never from the output of an AlloAgent tool; the tool calls of the 'tool check' only confirm that the tool can return the same fact.

asd_ap.source: the Allosteric Set Database release 202306 (the AP table)
asd_ap.origin: https://github.com/mpirgu/ASD (the release archive in the local ASD download)

asd_hl.source: the Allosteric Set Database release 202306 (the HL table: the curated modulators and their activity types)
asd_hl.origin: the ASD release archive in the local ASD download

biolip.source: BioLiP (the binding-site table: PDB, chain, ligand, binding-site residues, affinity)
biolip.origin: the BioLiP release used by the AlloAgent data lake

pm_labels.source: the PocketMiner authors' published test-set labels (Meller et al.) and their apo structures
pm_labels.origin: https://github.com/Mickdub/pocketminer (the dataset shipped in the image)

pm_ref.source: the PocketMiner authors' reference implementation and checkpoint (not the AlloAgent wrapper)

pdb.file: the RCSB PDB coordinate files (mmCIF / PDB)
pdb.source: the RCSB PDB (5EHR, 3O96, 5MO4) and the local read-only structure cache

uniprot.source: the UniProt REST records (the domain features of P31749)
uniprot.local_copy: the public REST record (the container has internet access)

ccd.file: the RCSB Chemical Component Dictionary for AY7
ccd.source: the RCSB CCD (the ChEMBL and PubChem identifiers of the 5MO4 myristoyl ligand)

the_tool_check.what_it_is: Each needed tool was called directly in the eval image (no LLM) and its output compared with the key above. The result of each call is in the 'the_tool_check_result' field.

the_tool_check_result.asd.parse_asd_xf: OK for P00519, P35557 and P31749: the 202306 XF records and the pdb_entries list come back for each accession
the_tool_check_result.biolip.parse_biolip_interactions: OK: 989058 records; the P18031 rows 409, of which 92 carry a recorded affinity; the AY7 rows 3 (5MO4 chain A, 8SSN chains A and B)
the_tool_check_result.pocketminer.pocketminer_score: OK: on the authors' apo structures the tool returns exactly the reference implementation's scores (6HB0: 0.926939, 0.904469, 0.89051, 0.889284, 0.882455; 2LAO: 0.93533, 0.919266, 0.902997, 0.902111, 0.899701)
the_tool_check_result.get_chembl_bioactivity: OK: the KRAS target CHEMBL2189121 gives sotorasib 8 IC50 records (median 49 nM) and adagrasib 7 (median 10 nM), matching the pinned SQL
the_tool_check_result.get_clinvar_variants: OK: the tool returns the ClinVar Allele ID (the release's #AlleleID column) as clinvar_id; for KRAS G12C it returns 27617 (the release row: #AlleleID 27617, VariationID 12578)
the_tool_check_result.get_alphamissense_score: OK: 11267 scored variants for Q06124 over 593 positions

the_tool_check.the_tool_failures: none: every call above succeeded. The failures seen during the check were in the harness, not in the tools: the BioLiP directory convention (the tool wants <dir>/biolip/biolip.pkl), the ClinVar significance spelling (the tool wants 'pathogenic', not 'Pathogenic'), and the AlphaMissense data path (the tool wants the release under /data/alphamissense).

the_live_service_cross_check.ChEMBL: the live public API for CHEMBL2189121 x CHEMBL4535757 (sotorasib) returns the same 8 IC50 records with the same median (49 nM) as the pinned ChEMBL 37, and the same 7 records with the same median (10 nM) for adagrasib; the pinned release is still the reference the items use, because the live service serves a later release in general
the_live_service_cross_check.ClinVar: the live service counts 392 pathogenic PTPN11 records against the pinned release's 568 pathogenic and 206 likely pathogenic (the pinned aggregate strings also carry 'Conflicting classifications of pathogenicity'); the counts therefore differ between the pinned release and the live service, which is why the X06 items are per-variant presence checks and the count carries a band of +/-2
